meta.title: Draft-strategy injury-survival simulation
meta.description: Monte-Carlo of historical 12-team PPR drafts using real ADP boards and real player outcomes, scored week-by-week under multiple waiver/replacement models. Emphasis on downside risk (worst-10% CVaR), not just average points.
notes: Weekly production ≈ player season ppg for every healthy week (byes ignored). ppg already excludes missed games, so healthy weeks score the true rate and injured weeks score the replacement value — isolating injury impact.
Injury out-weeks reconstructed from week_of_injury + weeks_missed / return_week / season_ending, clamped to weeks 1-14.

Replacement models change only how an unfillable starter slot (a 'hole') is valued: none/bestball = 0 (bestball auto-uses its full bench each week), normal = waiver-line ppg, aggressive = a strong streamer's ppg.
Standings/playoff/championship computed within each simulated 12-team league (target strategy vs 11 ADP-drafting opponents).
CVaR(10%) = average points among the worst 10% of a strategy's simulated outcomes.

strategies.label: RB-RB
strategies.description: Hammer the first two picks on running backs, then fill WR.

strategies.label: WR-WR
strategies.description: Open with two wide receivers before touching RB.

strategies.label: Hero RB
strategies.description: One elite RB in round 1, then load up on receivers.

strategies.label: Zero RB
strategies.description: Avoid RB early; stack WR/TE and take running backs late.

strategies.label: Early TE
strategies.description: Grab an elite tight end early for a positional edge.

strategies.label: Early QB
strategies.description: Lock a top quarterback early, then build skill positions.

strategies.label: Balanced
strategies.description: Alternate RB and WR, filling each starting slot in turn.

strategies.label: Robust RB
strategies.description: Build overwhelming RB depth in the first several rounds.
